narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Eight divided by two is four, so it is four times ten to the power seven.
<bookmark mark='over'/>The two is on top and the eight is below, so it is two divided by eight.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>He divided the wrong way round, so the bubble is wrong.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows 8 ÷ 2 = 4, so 4 × 10⁷; the 2 on top and the 8 below glow; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Work the numbers in front together and the powers of ten together. Then tidy into standard form.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Divide six times ten to the power eight by three times ten squared.
removed_beats.on_screen: the line numbers in front together, powers of ten together, then tidy appears; a new line (6 × 10⁸) ÷ (3 × 10²) appears with an empty box
